name: Calm connection pool
description: A pool that never queues. Checks that a quiet system reads as quiet.

name: Pool, slow build
description: Arrivals creep up until the queue starts to grow late in the run.

name: Pool, sudden spike
description: A short burst of traffic fills the pool and queues requests.

name: Pool, recovery
description: A long backlog that drains to zero before the end.

name: Pool, oscillating
description: Load rises and falls in waves, so the queue comes and goes.

name: API latency
description: p50 and p95 latency, request counts and two error bursts.

name: Server thermal throttle
description: CPU, memory and temperature with a heat event that triggers throttling.

name: Disk IO
description: Read and write throughput with a backup window that deepens the queue.

name: Network packet loss
description: Packet loss and round trip time with two bad stretches.

name: Sales with seasonality
description: A year of daily orders and revenue with weekly and yearly cycles and a sale.

name: IoT sensor drift
description: Two temperature sensors, one of which drifts away from the other.

name: Log events (JSON lines)
description: Request log events with status, latency and an incident window.

name: Malformed file
description: Rows with missing and extra columns. Importing it should fail with a clear message.

name: Large file (50,000 rows)
description: A long load series at the import row limit, for checking speed.
